entities.name: Calvin
entities.description: A rap musician and one of the two speakers. He moved into a mansion in Japan in spring 2023 and converted part of it into a recording studio, toured and recorded with Frank Ocean, released an album on 11 September 2023 and owns a red Ferrari. He planned a trip to Boston from March 2023 onwards and was meeting artists, sightseeing and attending a gala there by late 2023. Dave calls him Cal.

entities.name: Dave
entities.description: An automotive engineer and one of the two speakers, based in Boston. He has worked on cars since he was ten, opened his own car maintenance shop in May 2023, restored a vintage Ford Mustang he found in a junkyard, joined a rock band in June 2023, attended a car modification workshop in San Francisco in August 2023 and took up photography in autumn 2023.

entities.name: Frank Ocean
entities.description: The well-known musician Calvin tours and records with. Calvin gives two accounts of how they met: at a music festival in Tokyo, told on 22 August 2023, and at a festival in August 2022, told on 19 October 2023. Calvin secured a deal in August 2023 to continue the collaboration.

entities.name: Dave's father
entities.description: Dave's father, referred to only as 'my dad'. He took Dave to his first car show when Dave was ten, let him spend hours tinkering with engines in his garage, and spent one summer of Dave's childhood restoring an old car with him.

entities.name: Calvin's father
entities.description: Calvin's father, referred to only as 'my dad'. Calvin remembers a childhood road trip with him on which they sang along to 'California Love' by Tupac and Dr. Dre.

entities.name: Calvin's old high-school friend

properties.aliases: a high school friend, my old high school buddy

entities.description: Calvin's old friend from high school, with whom he used to freestyle and talk about getting famous as a teenager. They visited sights in Boston together on 24 October 2023, and Calvin invited him to a Boston performance in November 2023, saying his support and positivity have made a big difference.

entities.name: Japan
entities.description: The country Calvin moved to in spring 2023, having never been there before March 2023. He lives in a mansion there, collaborates with Japanese artists and had a custom guitar made by a Japanese artist friend. Dave has never been but wants to go, saying he is hooked on Japanese music.

entities.name: Tokyo
entities.description: The Japanese city where Calvin attended a music festival in April 2023, photographed the skyline on the night of 15 May 2023, performed to a large crowd, and planned to return in November 2023 to see Shibuya Crossing and Shinjuku. Dave has never been and wants to visit.

entities.name: Boston
entities.description: Dave's home city, whose music scene he describes as including Paradise Rock, House of Blues and Fenway Park. Calvin planned to visit from March 2023 onwards, gave inconsistent accounts of whether he had been there before, and by October and November 2023 was meeting artists, sightseeing with an old school friend and attending a gala there.

entities.name: Miami
entities.description: The city where Calvin shot the video for his new album, on a beach, from late August 2023; he said the Miami vibe was perfect for the video.

entities.name: San Francisco
entities.description: The city where Dave attended a car restoration and modification workshop in August 2023, returning to Boston on 1 September 2023 with new knowledge about car modification.

entities.name: Detroit
entities.description: The city where Dave attended a conference shortly before 25 October 2023, which he said he learned a lot from.

entities.name: Calvin's Japanese mansion

properties.aliases: my new mansion, my Japanese house, my Japanese mansion

entities.description: The mansion in Japan that Calvin's agent found for him and that he showed Dave on 23 March 2023 as his new mansion. He was living in it by July 2023 and admired the city skyline from its windows, converted part of it into a recording studio, recorded a song there with Frank Ocean in August 2023 and held an album party there in late October 2023.

entities.name: The park near Dave in Boston

properties.aliases: that beautiful park, my favourite spot, a nearby park

entities.description: The park in Boston that Dave visits to relax; he recommended it to Calvin on 23 March 2023, strolled there on 2 June 2023, arranged regular walks there with friends in July 2023 and photographed a waterfall at a serene spot in it in November 2023. Dave also speaks of Boston's parks in the plural, and those mentions are joined here as one place he keeps returning to.

entities.name: Dave's car maintenance shop
entities.description: The car maintenance shop Dave opened in May 2023 in Boston after years of dreaming about it, celebrating with friends. It handles everything from routine maintenance to full restorations of classic cars, and in October 2023 a competing shop won a deal it had chased for months. Dave also calls it his garage and has invited Calvin to visit it.

entities.name: Dave's rock band
entities.description: The rock band Dave joined shortly before 21 June 2023, playing guitar; he says he had been a fan of them for ages before getting the chance to join. They rehearse together, had a jam session on 14 September 2023 that they were too absorbed in to record, and created a band logo.

entities.name: Aerosmith
entities.description: The band Dave named as his favourite act at the music festival he attended in Boston in March 2023. It was the first time he had seen them live, and he did not get to meet them after the show.

entities.name: The Fireworks
entities.description: The band that headlined the music festival Dave returned from shortly before 15 October 2023, which he described as unreal.

entities.name: The car modification workshop in San Francisco

properties.aliases: car mod workshop, a car workshop in San Francisco

entities.description: The car modification workshop Dave was picked for in August 2023 and attended in San Francisco, returning on 1 September 2023. He called it a dream come true because he had always wanted to learn auto engineering and build a custom car. His mentions of 'a car mod workshop', 'a car workshop in San Francisco' and his San Francisco trip are joined here because they agree in date and subject.

entities.name: Calvin's album
entities.description: Calvin's album. He met its creative team for a long session on 8 June 2023, started shooting a video for it on a Miami beach over the weekend of 26-27 August 2023, said on 13 September 2023 that it had been released on 11 September to a warm reception, and threw a launch party at his Japanese mansion in the week before 2 November 2023. On 29 October 2023 he described the album as almost finished, which contradicts the release he had reported in September.

entities.name: California Love
entities.description: The song by Tupac and Dr. Dre that played on a childhood road trip Calvin took with his father, and which they sang along to. Calvin said on 22 September 2023 that it still makes him smile.

entities.name: Ratatouille
entities.description: The Disney film on a poster Calvin showed Dave on 15 September 2023. Calvin called it one of his favourites because it is about going after what you love, and Dave said it is one of his favourite Disney films for its lesson about following your dreams no matter what others say.

entities.name: Calvin's red Ferrari
entities.description: The red luxury sports car Calvin bought shortly before 26 March 2023, his first, which he took for a ride on 25 March 2023 and later calls his Ferrari. He had a minor accident in it on 16 June 2023, had the insurance and repairs settled within a week, and took it for a service in early August 2023. He describes long drives in it as relaxing and the car itself as a symbol of his hard work.

entities.name: Calvin's new Ferrari
entities.description: A further Ferrari that Calvin said on 15 October 2023 he had got in the week before, calling it a masterpiece on wheels. It is kept apart from the red sports car he bought in March 2023 because he described it as new rather than as the car he already had.

entities.name: Calvin's custom octopus guitar
entities.description: Calvin's custom guitar, made for him by a Japanese artist friend, carrying an octopus design that stands for his love of art and the sea and customised with a shiny purple finish to match his style. He calls it one of his favourites and a reminder of his passion for music and of the friendships he has made.

entities.name: Dave's vintage Ford Mustang
entities.description: The vintage Ford Mustang Dave found in a junkyard in bad shape and restored between August and October 2023, doing engine swaps, suspension work and body modifications and giving it a silver finish. He hoped to finish by the end of September 2023, heard a strange engine noise on 22 September, showed the finished car in October and said on 29 October 2023 that the restoration was done. His mentions of 'the car I'm restoring', 'the vintage Mustang' and 'that Ford Mustang I found in a junkyard' are joined here as one car.

entities.name: Dave's vintage camera
entities.description: The vintage camera Dave bought in November 2023 and uses for his photography, saying it captures special moments very clearly.

entities.name: Restoring and modifying cars
entities.description: Restoring, repairing and modifying cars. It has been Dave's passion since he was ten, became his living when he opened his shop in May 2023, and is the subject of the blog he started in late 2023; he calls it therapeutic and says it gives him a sense of purpose. Calvin also says that working on cars calms him down.

entities.name: Making music
entities.description: Writing, recording, collaborating and performing. It is Calvin's career - he experiments with genres, adds electronic elements, collaborates with artists in Japan and Boston and mentors young musicians - and a hobby for Dave, who plays guitar in a rock band and writes lyrics in a notebook.

entities.name: Photography
entities.description: Photography, which Dave took up in autumn 2023. He photographs the Boston skyline and its clock tower at sunset and the beauty of nature - sunsets, beaches, waves and waterfalls - and bought a vintage camera for it in November 2023.

entities.name: Walking in parks
entities.description: Walks in parks, which Dave uses to destress and recharge. He walks at weekends, explored parks through spring and summer 2023 and arranged regular walks with friends in July 2023.

entities.name: Calvin's tour with Frank Ocean
entities.description: Calvin's tour with Frank Ocean. The conversation's account of it is inconsistent: he speaks of it as still to be finished in April 2023, as having taken him to Tokyo in late May 2023, as ending soon on 22 August 2023, as over by 31 August 2023, and as newly started on 19 October 2023 with an end expected before a November 2023 trip to Tokyo.

entities.name: Calvin's recording studio in his Japanese mansion
entities.description: The recording studio in Calvin's Japanese mansion. He showed it as his creative haven in May 2023, described it in July 2023 as a project to transform the mansion into a recording studio and as his sanctuary for creating music with other artists, recorded a song there with Frank Ocean in August 2023, and makes beats there for young artists he mentors.
